title: Cheese and Bacon Turnover
subtitle: A flaky puff pastry parcel filled with cheddar and crispy bacon
excerpt: Puff pastry folded over a filling of melted cheddar and back bacon. Quick to make and good hot or at room temperature.
sourceNotes: British savoury pastry tradition, shaped as a simple folded turnover for ease.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze unbaked turnovers on a lined tray. Bake from frozen at 200C for 28 minutes.
recipe.batchNotes: Double the filling and cut four more pastry squares. Assemble and bake in two batches.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble and chill for up to four hours before baking.

content.text: This is a straightforward savoury turnover with sharp cheddar and salty bacon inside crisp puff pastry. The filling needs to be cool before it goes in or the pastry turns soft. Seal the edges firmly so nothing leaks during baking.
Fry the bacon in the frying pan over a medium heat until crisp. Tip onto a plate lined with kitchen paper and leave to cool completely.
Heat the oven to 200C. Line the baking tray with baking paper.
Unroll the pastry and cut it into four equal squares.
Spread a little mustard over one half of each square, leaving a 1cm border. Scatter the bacon and cheese over the mustard. Add a grind of black pepper.
Brush the border with beaten egg. Fold the pastry over to make a triangle and press the edges together firmly. Crimp with a fork.
Transfer to the lined tray. Brush the tops with beaten egg. Cut two small slits in each top.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes until deep gold and puffed. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

items.symptom: The filling leaks out during baking.
items.cause: The edges were not sealed tightly or the filling was too wet.
items.fix: Press and crimp the edges firmly with a fork. Pat the bacon dry before using.

items.cause: The filling was still warm when the pastry was assembled.
items.fix: Cool the bacon fully before assembling. Bake on the middle shelf on a preheated tray.

items.symptom: The pastry does not puff evenly.
items.cause: The filling was too thick in the centre.
items.fix: Keep the filling in a thin, even layer across one half of the square.
